data.one_liner: Provides UUID parsing, generation (v1, v4, v5) and comparison for Dart.
data.what_it_does: The package implements RFC4122 UUID handling, allowing creation from strings, byte arrays, and generation of time‑based, random, and name‑based UUIDs. It also offers comparable UUID objects for sorting.
use_when: You need to generate or parse UUIDs in a Dart or Flutter app
You require deterministic UUIDs (v5) or time‑based UUIDs (v1)
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution without native code
avoid_when: You need UUID versions not supported (v2, v3, v6, v7, v8)
You prefer a package with built‑in code‑generation utilities
strengths: Supports multiple UUID versions (v1, v4, v5)
Works on all Dart platforms (web, mobile, desktop)
weaknesses: Missing support for newer UUID specs (v6, v7, v8)
Limited to generation and parsing; no additional utilities

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar UUID generation and parsing with broader version support (including v3) and is widely used
